verdict.rationale: Vapi documents keypad input settings enabling DTMF tone reception/sending from callers (vapi-docs-45), which supports basic IVR interaction, but there is no explicit documentation of voicemail detection/leaving or dedicated IVR-menu-navigation tooling in the evidence pack. missing for 10: voicemail detection/answering-machine-detection feature docs, explicit IVR navigation guide, independent verification of DTMF sending in outbound calls.
